narration: On the afternoon of January 21st finds you at home.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: Citizens of this country, thank you for having me. I come with a plain belief that this country is on the edge of something good. Every President who stood here inherited troubles they did not choose. What they chose was how to meet them, and so will I.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: I begin this work with a glad heart, because I believe in the people I have come to serve. I accept this trust gladly, and I ask you to hold me to the best of what I have said.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: I believe free people, given room, build things no plan could have imagined, and I am eager to see what they build. To everyone who voted for someone else: I want your good ideas as much as anyone's, and I will go looking for them.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: There is a good deal to be glad about tonight, and I intend to enjoy it with you before we get back to work. Paychecks have grown faster than prices this year, and that is real progress for working people. The economy has grown this year, and the question now is whether that growth reaches the people who do the work. Not everyone has shared in it. Work has grown harder to find, and more Americans are looking for it than a year ago. None of that happened by accident. It happened because millions of people kept showing up, to work and to one another. Every American who wants to work should be able to find it, and until that is true, it is the first thing I will answer for.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: To the members of Congress: the people sent us here together, and they will judge us together. I mean to work with you, and I will come to you often.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: I would also be plain about what I will not do. Federal law answers legal cannabis sales with a no. Bring me a bill on legal cannabis sales and you will have my veto.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: Vice President Hannah Gregory has my trust, and in the years ahead the country will come to know why.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: This nation is its states before it is any one capital. To the governors and the lawmakers who serve them, I offer a partnership, and an open door.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: Whether you work a shift, run a shop or raise a family, this work is for you. The road ahead is long, and we will not walk all of it in my time. But we will walk it together, and we begin today. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America.

narration: Late in the morning on March 4th, you head out for the evening. You step up to the podium. The country is listening.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: Madam Speaker, members of Congress, fellow citizens, I am glad to be here tonight, because I have good reason to be hopeful about this country and I mean to tell you why.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: I am here to say how the country is doing, and the short version is that there is reason to be hopeful.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: I believe the next generation will do more with freedom than we dared, and I want to get out of their way.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: There is a good deal to be glad about tonight, and I intend to enjoy it with you before we get back to work. Paychecks have grown faster than prices this year, and that is real progress for working people. The economy has grown this year, and the question now is whether that growth reaches the people who do the work. But work has grown harder to find this year, and there are men and women in every part of the country still looking for it. None of that happened by accident. It happened because millions of people kept showing up, to work and to one another. Every American who wants to work should be able to find it, and until that is true, it is the first thing I will answer for.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: There is one thing on which I will not move. On legal cannabis sales, federal law says no. I will not lend my name to legal cannabis sales, and I will say so plainly.

nodes.speaker: Kevin Colon
nodes.text: To the family that sat down tonight and wondered whether this would change anything for them: it will, and I will show you. Thank you. God bless you all, and God bless this country.
